claims.reason: The only readable line says the mobile operator can use the device IMEI to disable the device. That concerns the handset, not the SIM card, and gives no advice to notify the operator of card loss or to secure the card. The card-specific advice is attributed in the item to the Apple page, which has no snapshot (blocked, HTTP 429).

claims.reason: Searched the Google snapshot 7d4296b28eab6e78.txt (whole kept text) for bank, unauthorised or foreign transactions, payment instruments and contacting a bank: nothing. The item attributes this advice to the Rzecznik Finansowy page, which has no snapshot (access blocked), so nothing readable backs it; this reflects an unreadable source, not a found contradiction.

Searched the Google snapshot 7d4296b28eab6e78.txt for police, reporting a theft, law enforcement: nothing (line 172 only mentions a stolen device and securing the Google account). The item's Korzyść i dowody attributes no police advice to any source. The Apple and Rzecznik Finansowy pages have no snapshot, so they could not be searched.

scope_gaps.note: Title speaks of securing the number and endangered accounts in general; the readable snapshot covers only Android device lock/erase and a pointer to securing the Google account.
Google snapshot covers Android and Wear OS only; the sentence addresses any phone and any manufacturer.
Snapshot mentions the IMEI (device), not the SIM card or its protection.
Only the Google half is checkable; Google page covers Android and Wear OS, not other Google products.
Only one of three cited sources has a snapshot.
Source describes Android and Wear OS only; the sentence does not name a platform, so a reader may assume it holds for iPhones as well (not verifiable here).
Source describes Android erase and reset only; the first clause is general and may be read as covering all phones.

notes: Opened only: AGENTS.md, the role file, the packet, and snapshot 7d4296b28eab6e78.txt. No protocol violation. The Apple page (HTTP 429, blocked) and the Rzecznik Finansowy page (HTTP 200, blocked) have no snapshot, so every claim attributed to them is source_unavailable or could not be searched; the item should be re-fetched before judging the police, bank and card advice. The Google snapshot footer says the Polish page may contain AI-translated text with errors, and line 37 is an untranslated English heading. Snapshot is the main region only (9122 of 11280 chars). Status FAIL comes only from W praktyce#3, #4 and #5 being unsupported recommendations; for #3 the cause is an unreadable source, not a contradiction.
